name: canfail
description: Prove your tests can actually fail. Finds checks that are green because they cannot go red.

scripts.demo:clean: npm run build && node dist/bin/canfail.js scan fixtures/clean-app
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/bin/canfail.js scan fixtures/greenwashed-app
scripts.verify:fixtures: npm run build && node dist/bin/canfail.js verify-fixtures fixtures/greenwashed-app
scripts.selfcheck: npm run build && node dist/bin/canfail.js scan . --exclude fixtures --no-mutate
